subject: Proxy logging, UK Addendum evidence and TIA sampling - next steps
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@healthbridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proxy logging & UK Addendum: sample logs and retention snapshot

Hi Kimberly,

Quick follow up from our compliance review — we have two asks to close the TIA scope for our UK pilot:

1) A sampling of edge/proxy logs that shows processing locality (ideally timestamps + egress IPs) for requests originating in the UK over a 24h window.
2) A short statement (or artifact) confirming that cached KV/prefix data used by the edge proxy is not persisted off-shore and will not be exported outside the UK/EU for this tenant.

We understand there may be redaction needs — a sanitized tarball is fine. Also flag if this triggers any subprocessor notifications (we need the subprocessor manifest for our legal team).

Can you confirm ETA for these items? We need something in-hand before our internal legal will sign the UK Addendum (we can share a DocuSign envelope after evidence).

Thanks,
Emma
Security & Privacy, HealthBridge
security@healthbridge.com

Attachments: none
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proxy logging & UK Addendum: sample logs and retention snapshot

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask. TL;DR: we can provide a redacted evidence package and a short control statement within 5 business days. Proposed plan below.

Plan / deliverables:
- Redacted syslog sample (24h window): timestamps, request_id, egress IP, region tag. We will remove any payloads and user identifiers. (file: syslog-sample-redacted.tgz)
- Log export CSV that maps request_id -> edge_region -> egress_ip (file: log-export-filtered.csv)
- Network flow manifest describing which proxies are operated by Redwood vs. third-party CDN/subprocessors (file: network-flow-manifest.txt)
- Short control note on cache persistence and KV lifetime for the tenant, signed by our infra lead (will include TTLs and encryption-at-rest statement).

Notes / clarifications:
- Our edge proxy keeps a transient cache (in-memory) for KV/prefix lookups with a max TTL of 6 hours; we do not persist KV cache to durable cross-region storage for hosted tenants unless the customer enables an opt-in persistence feature.
- For Dedicated/Private deployments we provide alternate controls; this package is scoped to Hosted + Dedicated fallback behavior.
- We will also indicate whether any of the proxies are operated by a subprocessor (we will list vendor names and locations).

Delivery and process:
- ETA: EOD Tuesday 18 Aug 2026 (we can accelerate to Mon 17 Aug if you need).
- Delivery via a secure Drive folder and an accompanying manifest PDF.
- If legal requires a signed attestation for the control note we can include a DocuSign-ready doc.

I will coordinate the artifacts with Markus and Laura — assigning internal owners below.

Action owners (internal):
- Markus: generate redacted syslog and export mapping
- Laura: compile subprocessor manifest and coordinate legal attestation
- Jonas: review network flows and redact per privacy rules

Kimberly
Head of Privacy Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

Attachments: uk-addendum-draft.docx (placeholder)
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Emma Jones <emma.jones@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 07:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proxy logging & UK Addendum: sample logs and retention snapshot

Hi team — technical follow up from infra:

What I'll include in the redacted package:
- syslog-sample-redacted.tgz: gzipped collection of rotated syslog files for a 24h window; we will redact IPs for internal hosts, preserve request_id and egress IPs only for client-facing proxies.
- log-export-filtered.csv: columns = request_id, timestamp_utc, edge_region, egress_ip, proxy_vendor. No user identifiers.
- network-flow-manifest.txt: lists CIDR ranges used by our edge fleet, vendor-operated proxies, and expected egress ASN ranges.

A few technical clarifications you asked about:
- KV cache: the runtime keeps model-kv caches in-memory per GPU worker and those are never flushed to long-term object stores in normal operation. For hosted tenants we have a fallback persistence option for disaster recovery — that feature is not enabled for your organization by default and we can confirm via config export.
- Cross-border telemetry: our telemetry pipeline aggregates anonymized metrics to a central EU telemetry cluster. Raw request-logs that include request_id are stored in-region for 30 days default; we can provide a scoped export as part of the TIA.

SCCs / UK Addendum note:
- Providing these artifacts doesn't require changing the SCCs or the UK Addendum language; it's evidence for the TIA scoping and operational safeguards. If legal wants a signed technical attestation referencing the UK Addendum sections we can produce one.

Timeline: I can produce the redacted artifacts by Mon 17 Aug (UTC) if I get confirmation on the exact 24h window you want. Otherwise Tue 18 Aug EOD as Kimberly noted.

Markus
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com

Attachments (to be included): syslog-sample-redacted.tgz, log-export-filtered.csv, network-flow-manifest.txt
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@healthbridge.com>

Kimberly / Markus — thanks, that plan sounds good. Accept the Mon 17 Aug delivery. For the 24h window please use 2026-08-05T00:00:00Z to 2026-08-05T23:59:59Z (this aligns with our test traffic).

Two quick asks before you send the artefacts:
- Can you include a one-paragraph signed attestation that confirms the KV cache non-persistence statement (just for our security binder)?
- Please confirm whether any of the listed proxies are operated by a US-based subprocessor — we need to understand if cross-border export is possible on a vendor-by-vendor basis.

If everything checks out we will add the UK Addendum signature to the DocuSign envelope and confirm next steps.

Emma
